Regardless of how satanic Finland is, Santa Claus was originally Saint Nicholas - a bishop from what is now Turkey. He died December 6, AD 343. There was no competing tradition back then, because the British colonists did not celebrate St. Nicholas' feast day (Dec. 6th), or Christmas. Thanks to the Protestant Reformation, Santa Claus is what we were stuck with. In time, nothing about the myth resembled Saint Nicholas.
